profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer at TULA Skincare
profile.summary: I am a self-taught IT professional that has learned through practical hands-on experience.  With an attention to detail and a fierce determination, I created my own experience as a freelance tech/programmer/administrator.  With that experience, I have been able to work in the past few years for demanding clients on high performance websites.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Google Analytics · npm · Ad Tech · Github · Mobile Devices · JavaScript · Web Development · Agile Methodologies · Requirements Analysis · Shopify · Start-ups · JSON · Nginx · HTML 5

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Teen Vogue:

•	Redesigned and optimized slideshow code and look, reducing the code from 4000 lines to fewer than 1200.  Slideshows had adaptive design for mobile as well as 4 different templates.  Slideshow page loads were reduced by 10%, and accounts for 80% of site traffic.
•	Site performance and functionality was hindered for a percentage of new users, especially Firefox users.  This was due to race conditions within the asynchronous code design of the site.  I was able to find and patch issues, could not complete a perfect solution due to time conditions, but problem was fully resolved.
•	Handled making numerous fixes and changes to site’s css, using sass and media queries for adaptive design.
•	Worked with other developers in giving guidance and help to complete their tasks.  Due to time zones, I would make myself available after work in order to help.

Brides:
 
•	Redesigned and optimized slideshow code and look, reducing the code from 4000 lines to fewer than 800, improving speed while increasing image size and increasing functionality (tablet swipe to next image, adding recommendations to end slide via AJAX call).  Slideshows account for nearly 90% of all traffic.
•	On brides, the site has gallery search functionality, allowing you to search through dresses, floral, anything bride related.  I worked with a colleague to port the results page into modules using backbone.js with require.js
•	Another portion of the gallery search functionality was the details page, giving a granular image by image view of results.  The original functionality made multiple AJAX calls, causing servers problems.  I was able to optimize the code to only use three AJAX calls per twenty images, by buffering AJAX responses and using data attributes on certain html elements.

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
•	Within the first week of employment, I was able to aid the team in making modifications and bug fixes to the EMA (European Music Awards) Gamification system, as the site was to go live for that very week.
•	Implemented Voting mechanism and security for the voting system for KCA (Kids Choice Awards).  Implementation was also used by mobile and Facebook teams.
•	Worked closely with back-end team to implement and troubleshoot HTML 5 video player for tablet experience of the KCAs.

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
La Redoute INTL: 

•	Added quick preview to product list pages, basket page and various other parts of the site.  Allows a user to view brief information about the product, as well as add to basket.  I made adjustments to the CSS given to me and implemented all the JavaScript functionality.
•	Worked on the redesign of the basket page.  The CSS was given to me, but major changes were needed for cross browser compatibility and to implement proper jQuery code.  Entire page was turned into an one-page webapp.  I worked closely with the backend developer to properly implement the javascript functionality.
•	Created a quick newsletter subscription for all pages using light-boxes.  Newsletter functionality was heavily dependent on the country site, I implemented all the necessary logic.
•	Created jQuery script for validation display.  Script is capable of showing plain text warnings, as well as floating bubble errors.  Bubble errors can be set to display from bottom, top, left and right.

La Redoute FR: 

•	Implemented a carousel for mobile devices.  Carousel use touch events for switching between panels, and uses AJAX to gather content.
•	Aided mobile development team in troubleshooting iPad related bugs.  
•	Added 360 degree product view, through pure JavaScript.  View also allows you to zoom into different angles as well.  Functionality works on the iPhone and android, allowing you to rotate product with touch events

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
MerckAcademy.com: 

•	Backend was created in PHP using MySQL, utilizing an open source framework (SnForge)
•	Communicated with Flash objects through External JS calls and JSON 
•	Tied links and JavaScript actions to Google analytics for reporting
•	Created custom JavaScript validation system and Light-Box displays with JQuery

MerckAcademy.com  (Mobile):

•	Reproduced original site to work on the iPhone
•	Reworked the CSS, HTML, JavaScript, video distribution, and back-end functionality to work with the iPhone’s screen and touch display
•	Creative use of CSS3 transitions to mimic scrolling so that we may include two hovering menus on screen, plus the use of HTML 5 for video playback

MSTags Project:

•	Microsoft’s version of the Google QRCode
•	I developed a system that would allow our clients to create a MSTag and link to a movie, and service also provided different formats of movie depending on phone capabilities
•	Service was also able to report and the how many people visited, as well as the make and model of the phone they were using

Neurology Speaker Portal:

•	Backend was created in PHP using MongoDB, utilizing an open source framework (SnForge) JavaScript functionality made using JQuery and SWFAddress 
•	Tied links and JavaScript actions to Google analytics and custom analytics engine for reporting
•	Created Custom sorting, searching, and filtering JavaScript JQuery Plug-in for the consultant Directory, where users can search for speakers.  Plug-in has built in options so it can be initialized for different datasets, also implemented the backend server response, sending JSON to the front-end

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
VivaStreet.com (Popular European and South America classifieds website):

•	The backend was developed in Object Orientated PHP in a custom built in-house MVC framework. 
•	Maintained tools for administrative, spam filtering and moderation teams. Expanded spam filtering tools to better identify spam
•	Worked closely with QA to maintain the current features of the site as well as adding new ones to improve traffic and user experience. Heavy use of JavaScript and Ajax to create a rich user experience
•	To increase performance of the site, we used memcache and other dynamic site accelerators, caching older versions of the site, and updating new information through AJAX.  AJAX included heavy use of JavaScript and JSON to operate
•	Extensive use of SQL to retrieve ad and user information and profile settings.  As well as reporting

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
PorscheDealer.com (Porsche dealerships websites):

•	Worked closely with Porsche  for major site changes and incorporating promotions and contest within the dealer sites.  Promotions and contest were closely monitor and logged to allow for reporting purposes.  For one promotion, I created a statistics dashboard, showing the effects of the promotion by advertisement.  All data was retrieved and stored in MySql database.
•	Inventory information was sent from Porsche daily and other third party providers.   I was in charge of maintaining data feeds, using a variety of formats.   There were over forty feeds for over one hundred companies.  All feeds affected the database, so SQL was used frequently
•	Analyzed web logs through use of PHP scripts and use of other third party log analyzers.
•	Added the ability to view the site in multiple languages utilizing utf-8.  The admin section was modified to allow the addition of content in other languages.  System remembers language preference for future visits
•	Sites were created using XHTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend, with an administrative section for dealers to make changes to many of the static content pages on the site.  There were also able to change contact information, and view reporting statistics
•	Performed major updates to dealer site.  Added front page specials on homepage that rotated and open in pop-ups.  The special ads had the ability to incorporate galleries and video, and were tracked for how many times customers viewed the material 
•	Worked with dealerships management and Porsche management on technical support and fixes to the site
•	Conducted meetings with Porsche management, as well as Porsche advertising agencies.  We would work together to tie in various promotions to the OEM dealer sites.  I worked with Porsche management and their advertising agencies to scope project.  I also worked with various third party vendors and freelance developers in order to complete the project.
